  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives within the Caribbean Community (CARICOM), which involves multiple countries. It addresses harmonization across institutions and countries, specifically focusing on the CARICOM Single Market and Economy (CSME) and the development of a regional qualifications framework. The paper discusses cross-border education, mutual recognition of qualifications, and credit transfer systems within the CARICOM region.
